note: urllib3 2.8.0. Each answer is the only def or class of that name in this commit.

tasks.question: Which function returns true when an HTTP connection has been dropped and should be closed?
Which function picks the address family passed to getaddrinfo when AF_UNSPEC should search both IPv6 and IPv4 DNS records?
Which function returns true when a connection must use HTTP CONNECT through a proxy?
Which function is the shortcut that builds request headers such as connection keep-alive and accept-encoding?
Which function rewinds a file-like request body to a saved position so a redirect or retry can send it again?
Which function turns a request body into chunks for socket.sendall and decides whether Content-Length or chunked transfer encoding applies?
Which function checks whether a file-like object is already closed, including objects that only expose isclosed?
Which function checks whether a response was produced by an HTTP request that used HEAD as its method?
Which function checks that a hex fingerprint, optionally written with colons, matches a certificate supplied as bytes?
Which function creates and configures an ssl.SSLContext for urllib3, negotiating the highest protocol both sides support?
Which function detects whether a hostname is an IPv4 address or an IPv6 address, including IPv6 addresses with zone IDs?
Which function verifies that a decoded peer certificate from getpeercert matches a hostname under the RFC 2818 and RFC 6125 rules?
Which class wraps an existing socket, establishes a TLS connection, and can chain multiple TLS connections for TLS within TLS?
Which function parses a possibly incomplete URL into a namedtuple of scheme, host, and the other RFC 3986 components?
Which class is a thread-safe mapping that keeps at most maxsize keys and throws away the least-recently-used keys beyond that?
Which class stores HTTP headers so field names compare case-insensitively, as RFC 7230 requires, and can hold multiple values for one field?
Which function builds a ProxyManager from a proxy URL string?
Which class routes PoolManager connections through a configured SOCKS proxy?
Which class is the memory-efficient buffer that holds decoded response bytes so read can return the exact amount the BufferedIOBase API asks for?
Which exception is raised when the maximum number of retries is exceeded for a request?
